Sixteen source files contain the string `comment.created` as a real occurrence. Three other files matched only because `comment.createdAt` contains it as a substring, so I excluded them: `comment-repository.ts`, `comment-thread.tsx` and `comment-item.tsx`.

**Source**
- `src/types/activity.ts` and `src/types/event.ts` hold the type definitions, including the event map key at `event.ts:70`.
- `src/schemas/activity.ts` and `src/schemas/webhook.ts` list the name in their schema enums.
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` emits the event at line 77 and mentions it in a docblock.
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`, `webhook-service.ts`, `search-service.ts` and `notification-service.ts` each subscribe to it.
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` maps it to the label "commented".
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts` mentions it only in a docblock comment (line 7), not in code. It still contains the string, so I included it.

**Tests**
- `tests/server/domain-events.test.ts`
- `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts`
- `tests/services/comment-service.test.ts`
- `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`
